selectionPolicy: Prioritized original-source review within bounded candidate pools. Explicit version, concrete work and model role required. Bilibili follows the user-approved 2026-10-15 relaxed standard, but all accepted Bilibili entries in this run document the task. Backend model identity and claimed outcomes are not independently verified.
note: Pool and queue counts overlap across topics and platforms and are not counts of unique works. Pending items include screened candidates without completed evidence review.
